_about: Synthetic scripts for the tts-asr gold corpus. Every person, place and number here is invented.
Markup: [[Kind|spoken text]] marks an identifier; the kind is an IdentifierKind name. Everything the
annotator would mark is marked, including kinds Silueta has no rule for (places, spoken dates, people
who are not on the roster) — leaving those out would flatter the number.
Written by Claude on 16 Sep 2026, the same author who wrote and changed the matcher, before any of
these documents was ever evaluated. That is not an independent test and every report says so.

documents.script: Shift report for [[PatientName|Eleanor Vasquez]]. [[StaffName|Sofia Reyes]] arrived at eight and stayed until two. [[PatientName|Ellie]] ate most of her breakfast and took the metformin with water. Her daughter [[FamilyName|Yamilet]] called from [[Address|Mesa]] and asked us to call her back at [[Phone|six oh two, five five five, oh one four seven]]. Blood pressure one thirty over eighty. No falls this week.

This is [[StaffName|Marcus Oyelaran]] with the evening visit for [[PatientName|Robert Szymanski]]. [[PatientName|Bob]] was in good spirits tonight. He is [[AgeOver89|ninety two years old]] and still does the crossword every morning. His son called about the cardiology appointment on [[Date|March fourteenth]]. Pain two out of ten. Next visit is Thursday.

[[StaffName|Maria Chen]] covered the morning shift for [[PatientName|Maria Lopez]]. Mrs. [[PatientName|Lopez]] slept poorly and asked twice for her husband, who passed away in [[Date|June]]. [[StaffName|Maria]] helped her shower and changed the dressing on her left heel. The wound looks smaller. Her neighbor Mr. [[OtherName|Okafor]] stopped by with soup.

Visit note. [[StaffName|Grace Whitfield]] here with [[PatientName|Li Wang]]. [[PatientName|Li]] was already dressed and sitting by the window when I arrived. We walked to the end of [[Address|Cactus Road]] and back. Oxygen saturation ninety five percent. He asked me to remind his granddaughter about the pharmacy pickup on Friday the [[Date|twentieth]].

Call log. [[FamilyName|Tuan Nguyen]] called about his mother, [[PatientName|Margaret Nguyen]]. He said [[PatientName|Maggie]] fell asleep during lunch again. I told him [[StaffName|Hope]] will check her blood sugar tomorrow at nine. He wants a callback at [[Phone|four eight oh, five five five, two two one nine]] or by email at [[Email|tuan dot nguyen at example dot com]].

[[StaffName|James Carter]] reporting. [[PatientName|Dolores Echeverria]] refused her morning medication and said it makes her dizzy. She is [[AgeOver89|ninety six]]. I called Dr. [[OtherName|Patel]] at the [[Address|Tempe]] clinic and left a message. Her medical record number is [[RecordNumber|four four one seven two nine]]. I will try the medication again at noon.

Evening shift. [[StaffName|Kevin Brooks]] with [[PatientName|May Thompson]]. In [[Date|May]] we started the new walker and she uses it well now. Her sister [[FamilyName|Rose]] visited and brought roses from the garden. [[PatientName|May]] ate soup and half a sandwich. We talked about her trip to [[Address|Flagstaff]] next month.

This is [[StaffName|Paul Anderson]]. Quick update on [[PatientName|Xiadani Ortiz]]. She had a low grade fever this afternoon, ninety nine point four. Her appointment was moved to [[Date|October second]]. Her caregiver asked that we text [[Phone|six two three, five five five, oh nine eight eight]] before the visit instead of knocking.

[[StaffName|Itzel Ramirez]] here. Mr. [[PatientName|Blackwood]] was confused this morning and thought it was nineteen sixty. [[PatientName|Harold]] calmed down after breakfast. His wife says this happens after a bad night. He is [[AgeOver89|ninety one years old]]. We should flag it for the nurse on Monday.

Visit summary from [[StaffName|Derek Lin]]. [[PatientName|Patricia Quinones]] completed all her exercises today. [[PatientName|Patty]] says the knee feels stronger. We practiced the stairs twice. Her insurance called to confirm the address, [[Address|four twelve West Palm Lane]]. Next visit Tuesday afternoon.

[[StaffName|Ana Torres]] with the morning report. [[PatientName|Walter Okonkwo]] was up early. His daughter [[FamilyName|Grace]] stayed overnight and says he coughed a lot. By the grace of good timing the nurse was already scheduled. [[PatientName|Walter]] denies chest pain. Temperature normal.

Evening note by [[StaffName|Brian Kowalski]]. [[PatientName|Guadalupe Ibanez]] had a good day. Her family calls her [[PatientName|Lupita]]. She is [[AgeOver89|ninety eight]] and sharp as ever. She reminded me her birthday is [[Date|August ninth]]. Her grandson will visit from [[Address|Tucson]] on Sunday.

[[StaffName|Nadia Haddad]] reporting on [[PatientName|Theodore Marsh]]. [[PatientName|Teddy]] skipped lunch and said his stomach hurts. I checked his record, number [[RecordNumber|seven seven three one four]], and the new antibiotic started yesterday. I called his son at [[Phone|four eight oh, five five five, seven six one oh]]. No answer, left a voicemail.

Call from [[FamilyName|Jesus Martinez]], son of [[PatientName|Consuelo Martinez]]. [[FamilyName|Chuy]] says his mother did not sleep and asked for [[StaffName|Eric]] by name. He wants the Saturday visit moved to the [[Date|twenty third]]. I confirmed with [[StaffName|Eric Johansson]] and he agreed.

Short note. [[StaffName|Sam Osei]] visited [[PatientName|Ruth Abernathy]] today. [[PatientName|Ruth]] is [[AgeOver89|one hundred and one]] and told me about growing up in [[Address|Prescott]]. Her daughter in law handles the bills. Vitals stable. She asked that nobody call before ten.

Reporte de turno de [[StaffName|Rosa Villanueva]]. La señora [[PatientName|Guadalupe Hernández]] desayunó bien y se tomó la metformina. [[PatientName|Lupita]] dice que le duele la rodilla izquierda. Su hija llamó desde [[Address|Hermosillo]] y pidió que le regresemos la llamada al [[Phone|seis cero dos, cinco cinco cinco, cero uno cuatro siete]]. Presión ciento treinta sobre ochenta.

Habla [[StaffName|Pilar Montoya]] con la visita de la tarde. Don [[PatientName|José Echeverría]] estaba de buen humor. [[PatientName|Pepe]] tiene [[AgeOver89|noventa y tres años]] y todavía hace crucigramas. Su nieto preguntó por la cita del [[Date|catorce de marzo]]. Dolor dos de diez. La próxima visita es el jueves.

[[StaffName|Luz Carrillo]] cubrió el turno de la mañana con [[PatientName|Luz Ochoa]]. La señora [[PatientName|Ochoa]] no durmió bien y pidió que dejáramos la luz prendida. [[StaffName|Luz]] le cambió el vendaje del talón. La herida se ve más pequeña. La vecina doña [[OtherName|Chela]] trajo caldo.

Nota de visita. Aquí [[StaffName|Sol Aguirre]] con [[PatientName|Ignacio Tlapa]]. A [[PatientName|Nacho]] le gusta sentarse al sol por la mañana. Caminamos hasta la esquina de la [[Address|calle Morelos]] y regresamos. Saturación noventa y cinco por ciento. Me pidió recordarle a su nieta la receta del viernes [[Date|veinte]].

Registro de llamada. [[FamilyName|Alberto Iturbide]] llamó por su mamá, [[PatientName|Concepción Iturbide]]. [[FamilyName|Beto]] dice que [[PatientName|Concha]] se quedó dormida en la comida otra vez. Le dije que [[StaffName|Paz]] le va a checar el azúcar mañana a las nueve. Quiere que le hablen al [[Phone|seis dos tres, cinco cinco cinco, dos dos uno nueve]] o que le escriban a [[Email|beto punto iturbide arroba ejemplo punto com]].

Reporta [[StaffName|Andrés Beltrán]]. La señora [[PatientName|Socorro Xicoténcatl]] no quiso la medicina de la mañana porque dice que la marea. Tiene [[AgeOver89|noventa y seis años]]. Llamé a la doctora [[OtherName|Ibáñez]] a la clínica de [[Address|Nogales]] y le dejé recado. Su número de expediente es [[RecordNumber|cuatro cuatro uno siete dos nueve]].

Turno de la noche. [[StaffName|Víctor Garza]] con [[PatientName|Mar Salcedo]]. [[PatientName|Mar]] habló mucho de sus vacaciones en el mar cuando era joven. Su hermana [[FamilyName|Rosario]] vino a verla y le trajo pan dulce. Cenó sopa y medio sándwich. Quiere ir a [[Address|Guaymas]] el próximo mes.

Habla [[StaffName|Ramón Esquivel]]. Actualización rápida de [[PatientName|Yuridia Tzompa]]. En la tarde tuvo un poco de fiebre, treinta y siete punto ocho. Su cita se movió al [[Date|dos de octubre]]. Su cuidadora pidió que le mandemos mensaje al [[Phone|cuatro ocho cero, cinco cinco cinco, cero nueve ocho ocho]] antes de llegar.

Aquí [[StaffName|Itzel Cuauhtli]]. Don [[PatientName|Francisco Villaseñor]] amaneció confundido y pensaba que era mil novecientos sesenta. [[PatientName|Paco]] se calmó después del desayuno. Su esposa dice que le pasa después de una mala noche. Tiene [[AgeOver89|noventa y un años]]. Hay que avisarle a la enfermera el lunes.

Resumen de visita de [[StaffName|Daniel Ortega]]. [[PatientName|Eva Ruiz]] terminó todos sus ejercicios. [[PatientName|Eva]] dice que la rodilla ya está más fuerte. Practicamos las escaleras dos veces. Del seguro llamaron para confirmar el domicilio, [[Address|calle Álamo cuatrocientos doce]]. La próxima visita es el martes.

[[StaffName|Cruz Fonseca]] con el reporte de la mañana. [[PatientName|Tomás Acuña]] se levantó temprano. Su hija [[FamilyName|Dolores]] se quedó a dormir y dice que tosió mucho. Le dolía la cabeza y le dieron dolores de espalda en la noche. [[PatientName|Tomás]] niega dolor de pecho. Temperatura normal.

Nota de la tarde de [[StaffName|Marisol Quintanilla]]. [[PatientName|Refugio Anaya]] tuvo un buen día. En su familia le dicen [[PatientName|Cuca]]. Tiene [[AgeOver89|noventa y ocho años]] y está muy lúcida. Me recordó que su cumpleaños es el [[Date|nueve de agosto]]. Su nieto viene de [[Address|Tucson]] el domingo.

Reporta [[StaffName|Nayeli Huerta]] sobre [[PatientName|Eusebio Garcilazo]]. [[PatientName|Chebo]] no quiso comer y dice que le duele el estómago. Revisé su expediente, número [[RecordNumber|siete siete tres uno cuatro]], y el antibiótico nuevo empezó ayer. Le hablé a su hijo al [[Phone|seis cero dos, cinco cinco cinco, siete seis uno cero]] y no contestó.

Llamada de [[FamilyName|Julián Zambrano]], hijo de [[PatientName|Ofelia Zambrano]]. Dice que su mamá no durmió y preguntó por [[StaffName|Aurora]]. Quiere cambiar la visita del sábado al [[Date|veintitrés]]. Lo confirmé con [[StaffName|Aurora Peña]] y está de acuerdo. Desde la aurora ya estaba despierta.

Nota corta. [[StaffName|Hugo Solís]] visitó a [[PatientName|Cándida Ybarra]]. Doña [[PatientName|Cándida]] tiene [[AgeOver89|ciento un años]] y me contó cómo creció en [[Address|Álamos]]. Su nuera se encarga de las cuentas. Signos vitales estables. Pidió que nadie llame antes de las diez.
